stemMd: Choose the correct comparison: "Of the two routes, the riverside path is ___."
explanationMd: The sentence compares exactly two routes. Use the single comparative form "shorter," avoiding either a superlative or a doubled comparative.

distractorRationale.c: The superlative normally compares three or more, while the sentence specifies two.
distractorRationale.a: This awkward superlative does not fit a comparison of two routes.
